lines.racing3d.title: RACING
lines.racing3d.join: PLAYER 2: PRESS 2 OR START ON A PAD

notes.racing3d.boot: A step on the loading screen while the game builds the valley and its kart circuit.
notes.racing3d.title: The slice's own title over its menu (a kart racing game).
notes.racing3d.menu.race: The menu: a race against five computer drivers, a race for two players on a split screen, or back to the title.
notes.racing3d.menu.vs: VS: versus, two players against each other.
notes.racing3d.join: Waiting for a second player: 2 is the keyboard's 2 key, START a gamepad's Start button.
notes.racing3d.after.again: The menu after a race's results: race again, or back to the race menu.
notes.racing3d.note.behind: The camera just changed to the one behind the kart.
notes.racing3d.note.view: The camera just changed to a view; {view} is its name (iso, top-down). Shown in capitals.
notes.racing3d.hud.drift: A drift held long enough to charge a boost (blue sparks); TURBO! when it is fully charged (orange sparks). Keep both short.
notes.racing3d.board.row: A row of the results board: the finishing place as a plain number (1. NOVA), then the driver's name.
notes.racing3d.driver.nova: The six drivers' names (the player drives NOVA): keep them, or write them in your letters.
notes.action.gas: A control's name on the controls screen: accelerate.
notes.action.brake: A control's name on the controls screen: brake (and reverse).
notes.action.drift: A control's name on the controls screen, and in capitals on its touch button: hop and drift through a bend.
notes.action.item: A control's name on the controls screen, and in capitals on its touch button: use the item held (a boost, a shell, a peel).

brief: The 3D racing slice: a kart circuit in a green valley, like Mario Kart 64: you and five drivers, three laps, drifts that charge a boost, item boxes, a dirt shortcut, and a split screen for two players. The words are short menus, HUD notes and a results board, in capitals and upbeat. The player is addressed as "you" only in the manual; their driver, NOVA, is never gendered in the words.
